title: Humanoid ROS 2 SDK
description: A humanoid robotics architecture that routes sensor data, joint states, and motor CAN I/O through ROS 2, with MoveIt 2 models and feedback-control interfaces.

title: Humanoid Vision & Head Tracking
description: A C++ ROS 2 perception pipeline combining YOLO detection, optional TensorRT acceleration, aligned RealSense depth-to-3D estimation, and visual-servo head tracking through an ESP32 micro-ROS controller.

title: ROS 2 Robotic Sorting System
description: A modular ROS 2 Humble and MoveIt 2 stack connecting object classification to bin-placement decisions, grasp planning, and manipulation execution.

title: Autonomous Rotorcraft Flight Control
description: A multi-sensor Pixhawk flight-control pipeline for attitude control, state monitoring, trajectory tracking, onboard video, and target tracking.

title: Robot Motion Planning & Path Search
description: Implementations and analysis of graph search, reactive planning, and roadmap methods across discrete and geometric planning problems.

title: ROS 2 HTTP Gateway
description: A lightweight Python gateway and C++ processing-node architecture for network-triggered image workloads, message forwarding, and lifecycle-style coordination.

title: Autonomous Vehicle Following System
description: A ROS 2 prototype combining perception, motion decisions, OAK-D sensing, LiDAR-triggered emergency braking, and real-time control.
